title: Minimal Warp Leap Challenge
description: A starship captain wants to travel across a series of checkpoints plotted along a galactic highway. Each checkpoint features a hyperdrive engine with a specific maximum leap range. The captain wants to reach the final checkpoint using the absolute minimum number of warp leaps. Given an array of integers representing the maximum leap distance from each checkpoint, find the minimum number of leaps required to reach the last index.
constraints: It is guaranteed that you can reach the final checkpoint.
input_format: An array of integers representing maximum leap lengths.
output_format: An integer representing the minimum number of leaps to reach the last index.

examples.explanation: The minimum number of leaps to reach the last index is 2. Leap 1 step from index 0 to 1, then 3 steps to the last index.
Leap from index 0 to 1, then leap from index 1 to the end.
Leap from index 0 to 1, then from index 1 to index 2.
